item.title: Newly released Brentwood police bodycam video shows arrest of Yolanda Ramirez
item.description: (KRON) -- There is newly released Brentwood police bodycam footage of the arrest of Yolanda Ramirez. The 72-year-old Brentwood woman died days after an interaction with police last September. As KRON4's Noelle Bellow reports, Ramirez’s family believes the footage proves police are responsible for her death.
